newsitem.title: USA: Robomatix says CEO to step down.
newsitem.headline: Robomatix says CEO to step down.

text.p: Robomatix Technologies Ltd said Monday said that by mutual agreement, its general manager and chief executive officer, Shlomo Berkovitch, will step down on January 28.
The company said Berkovitch's functions will temporarily be performed by Inon Perry, vice chairman of the board.
It said Perry, who is also chairman of the board's executive committee, has been overseeing implementation of the company's restructuring program.

Robomatix, through its subsidiary Associative Computing Ltd, makes semiconductor chips for high-speed computing and through its Micronic Inspection unit develops inspection systems for computer industry products. It also makes advanced industrial automation systems that use laser-based robotics components.
